scope: Requirements for the model-level MBD process: Plant (96s1p Samsung SDI 60Ah, BMW i3 dataset), BMS (1 master + 8 slaves), and embedded LSTM fault predictor. Verified under MIL, SIL, PIL.

phase_descriptions.PLANT: Validate the closed-loop virtual battery plant against the BMW i3 measurement dataset. Standalone phase, independent from the BMS MIL/SIL/PIL pipeline. Verifies the plant model is fit-for-purpose before it is used as the reference for BMS verification.
phase_descriptions.MIL: Verify functional logic and algorithms of the BMS and the embedded LSTM predictor against the virtual plant in simulation, before any code generation.
phase_descriptions.SIL: Confirm that the generated C-code of bms_master and bms_slave behaves identically to the original Simulink model on the host computer; identify numerical overflows, memory errors and code-generation artefacts early.
phase_descriptions.PIL: Ensure the generated software runs correctly on the STM32H7A3 target MCU; verify real-time execution performance, processor compatibility, and LSTM inference correctness on the ARM Cortex-M7 while the plant remains a simulation.

high_level.text: The closed-loop plant (cell_ecm_2rc -> module_12s -> pack_96s with coolant loop, heater and chiller) SHALL converge to the BMW i3 measurement dataset on V_pack, SoC and T_pack across the 70 measurement trips.

The BMS (bms_master + bms_slave) SHALL provide: cell-voltage monitoring, cell-temperature monitoring, pack-current monitoring, fault detection with debouncing, fault-severity state machine, SoC estimation, SoH estimation, cell balancing, thermal management, power limitation, slave watchdog, and an independent hardware protection path.
The BMS SHALL be a modular master/slave architecture: exactly one bms_master and exactly eight bms_slave instances, one slave per 12-cell module of the 96s1p pack.
The BMS SHALL be verified under MIL and SIL on the host computer, and under PIL on the STM32 Nucleo-H7A3ZI-Q target.

The embedded LSTM fault predictor SHALL output, at every BMS step, a per-class probability vector prob_3 and a binary alarm vector alarm_3 for the three classes (OT, OV, UV), and SHALL raise alarms ahead of the corresponding BMS warn-level fault flags. The predictor is informational only: it SHALL NOT take any proactive action on the plant.

The smart BMS (bms_master + bms_slave + embedded fault_predictor) SHALL contain no dead design elements: every block, decision branch, condition and Stateflow transition SHALL be reachable by the BMS validation stimulus.

low_level.text: Both the median AND the mean of RMSE(V_pack) computed across the 70 measurement trips SHALL be <= 4.0 V (= 1 % of the 384 V nominal pack voltage = 40 mV per cell averaged over 96 series cells).
Both the median AND the mean of RMSE(SoC_pack) computed across the 70 measurement trips SHALL be <= 1 %.
Both the median AND the mean of RMSE(T_pack) computed across the 70 measurement trips SHALL be <= 1 degC.

Voltage_Monitor SHALL raise OV warn when any V_cell > bms.V_OV_warn (4.15 V) for >= bms.N_debounce_warn samples, OV derate when V_cell > bms.V_OV_derate (4.20 V) for >= bms.N_debounce_derate samples, and OV shut when V_cell > bms.V_OV_shut (4.25 V) for >= bms.N_debounce_shut samples.

Voltage_Monitor SHALL raise UV warn when any V_cell < bms.V_UV_warn (2.80 V) for >= bms.N_debounce_warn samples, UV derate when V_cell < bms.V_UV_derate (2.60 V) for >= bms.N_debounce_derate samples, and UV shut when V_cell < bms.V_UV_shut (2.50 V) for >= bms.N_debounce_shut samples.

Temperature_Monitor SHALL raise OT warn when any T_sensor > bms.T_OT_warn (45 degC) for >= bms.N_debounce_warn samples, OT derate when T_sensor > bms.T_OT_derate (55 degC) for >= bms.N_debounce_derate samples, and OT shut when T_sensor > bms.T_OT_shut (60 degC) for >= bms.N_debounce_shut samples.

Temperature_Monitor SHALL raise UT warn when any T_sensor < bms.T_UT_warn (0 degC) for >= bms.N_debounce_warn samples, UT derate when T_sensor < bms.T_UT_derate (-10 degC) for >= bms.N_debounce_derate samples, and UT shut when T_sensor < bms.T_UT_shut (-20 degC) for >= bms.N_debounce_shut samples.

Current_Monitor SHALL raise OC-charge warn when I_pack < -bms.I_OC_chg_warn (-150 A) for >= bms.N_debounce_warn samples, derate at -bms.I_OC_chg_derate (-200 A), and shut at -bms.I_OC_chg_shut (-300 A) with the matching debounce counts.

Current_Monitor SHALL raise OC-discharge warn when I_pack > bms.I_OC_dchg_warn (350 A) for >= bms.N_debounce_warn samples, derate at bms.I_OC_dchg_derate (420 A), and shut at bms.I_OC_dchg_shut (500 A) with the matching debounce counts.

Fault_Severity_FSM SHALL escalate Nominal -> Warn -> Derate -> Shutdown using the debounced fault flags, and SHALL recover Warn -> Nominal automatically when all flags clear for >= bms.N_debounce_warn samples. Shutdown SHALL latch and require an external reset.
EKF_SoC_Estimator SHALL converge SoC_pack to within 3 % absolute of the truth within 60 s, starting from a 2 % initial-condition error, on a constant 30 A discharge.
SoH_Estimator output SHALL remain inside [0.5, 1.0] and SHALL be non-increasing within a single trip (monotonic-decay tolerance: 1e-4 per step).

Cell_Balance_Ctrl SHALL output I_bal_12 = 0 when enable_bal is false. When enable_bal is true, the cell with the highest V SHALL receive a non-zero discharge current of magnitude bms.bal_I_nom (0.25 A).

On the longest available measured trip, the maximum cell-voltage spread max(V_cells) - min(V_cells) over the trip SHALL stay within the OEM safety envelope of 200 mV. Justification: passive balancing at bms.bal_I_nom = 0.25 A cannot beat the dynamic IR-drop differences within a single high-current trip; the BMS guarantee is that the spread is BOUNDED, not that it is reduced by an arbitrary % over a short rest window. Full equalisation accumulates across multiple high-SoC rest periods (e.g. overnight charging). This criterion mirrors the validated test_integration_balancing_trip in the previous project release.

Thermal_Manager SHALL assert P_heat_cmd when T_pack < T_heat_on (8 degC) and de-assert at T_pack >= T_heat_off (18 degC); SHALL assert P_chill_cmd when T_pack > T_cool_on (35 degC) and de-assert at T_pack <= T_cool_off (25 degC). Heater and chiller SHALL never be active simultaneously.
Power_Limiter SHALL reduce P_limit_chg and P_limit_dchg by >= 20 % when fault_severity = Derate, and SHALL force both to 0 W when fault_severity = Shutdown.
Slave_Watchdog SHALL escalate fault_severity to >= Warn when any slave fault_flag stream is frozen (no value change) for >= bms.N_watchdog_timeout (100) consecutive BMS steps.
Signal_Aggregator min/max trees in bms_master SHALL report the correct extremum across all 96 cell voltages and all 32 temperature sensors when a spike or dip is moved across every channel index.
Per-slave MinMax aggregator and balancer cell-argmax SHALL identify the correct cell index when the spike/dip moves across every cell of the 12-cell module.

Balancing_Arbitrator SHALL select different modules for balancing as the cell-spread pattern moves across the pack while SoC > bms.bal_SoC_min and current is near rest, ensuring every module is exercised at least once over the sweep.
Per-slave fault propagation: each of the 8 slave channels in fault_flags_8, taken alone, SHALL be sufficient to drive the master FSM through Warn -> Derate -> Shut as severity increases.

Decode_Fault_Flags SHALL walk every fault class (OV/UV/OT/UT) through none -> warn -> derate -> shut on a single slave at a time using the encoded fault_flags_8 input (2 bits per class: OV=bits0-1, UV=bits2-3, OT=bits4-5, UT=bits6-7).
Power_Limiter min(k_soc, k_temp) selector SHALL pick k_soc when SoC is low (warm cells) and SHALL pick k_temp when SoC is nominal but cells are very cold.
Sustained discharge accumulating |dSoC| >= 10 % SHALL trigger one update of SoH_cap_est via the coulomb-counting branch, and a sustained high-current segment SHALL update R0 via the EMA branch.
Thermal_Manager SHALL hit heater/chiller saturation limits and SHALL cross both relay edges (turn-on and turn-off hysteresis) when temperature is swept across the full operating range.

Slave_Watchdog severity SHALL scale with the count of frozen slave channels: 0 frozen -> Nominal, 1 -> Warn, 2-3 -> Derate, 4+ -> Shut, after each channel exceeds bms.N_watchdog_timeout consecutive frozen steps.
HW_Protection_Path SHALL assert shutdown_cmd within a single BMS step (no debounce) when |I_pack| >= bms.I_SC_thresh (800 A) OR any V_cell >= bms.V_OVP2_thresh (4.50 V).

Across all OT injection scenarios x test-split trips, the median per-event alarm_3(OT) lead time vs the BMS Nominal->Warn(OT) transition SHALL be >= req.PRD_LT_OT_min_s (30 s, equal to the LSTM training horizon H_OT=300 samples at dt=0.1 s). Lead = (y_true_start - first_alarm_idx)*dt + H*dt, where y_true marks samples within H of a warn crossing.

Across all OV injection scenarios x test-split trips, the median per-event alarm_3(OV) lead time vs the BMS Nominal->Warn(OV) transition SHALL be >= req.PRD_LT_OV_min_s (10 s, equal to H_OV=100 samples).

Across all UV injection scenarios x test-split trips, the median per-event alarm_3(UV) lead time vs the BMS Nominal->Warn(UV) transition SHALL be >= req.PRD_LT_UV_min_s (10 s, equal to H_UV=100 samples).

Per-class sample-level detection rate (TP / (TP + FN)) on the injected-fault test split SHALL be >= 75 % for each of the three classes (OT, OV, UV). Aggregated across all (class scenario, test trip) pairs. Justification: the trained LSTM's documented per-class recall on the held-out test split (ai/fault_prediction/models/test_report.json) is OT=0.999, OV=0.796, UV=0.883; OV is the binding rare-event class. The 75 % floor reflects the validated model's documented capability with margin for closed-loop stochasticity (cell-variability seed, EKF transients).
On the set of nominal trips (no injected faults), the fraction of trip duration during which any alarm_3(c) is asserted SHALL be <= 10 %.

For every BMS functional test scenario (voltage/temperature/current monitoring, FSM, EKF, SoH, balancing, thermal management, power limiter, slave watchdog), the generated C-code executed in SIL mode on the host SHALL produce outputs (fault_severity, SoC_pack, SoH_pack, P_limit_chg, P_limit_dchg, enable_bal_8, prob_3, alarm_3) that match MIL outputs to within 1 % relative tolerance (or 1e-4 absolute for near-zero values). This confirms that no numerical overflow, memory error, or code-generation artefact has been introduced.

bms_master SHALL execute one BMS step in <= req.RT_WCET_max_us (10 ms = 10% CPU load at the 100 ms BMS tick) on the STM32 Nucleo-H7A3ZI-Q (Cortex-M7 @ 280 MHz), measured as the MAX over at least req.RT_WCET_min_steps consecutive PIL steps at Ts = 100 ms (after skipping req.RT_WCET_warmup cold-start steps for LSTM weight load + cache priming) by Embedded Coder code-execution profiling sampled on the free-running 32-bit TIM5 counter (1 tick = 1/280 MHz = 3.57 ns). The HAL 1 kHz time base is relocated from TIM5 to TIM7 in the CubeMX .ioc to free TIM5 for profiling. NVIC priorities (PriorityGroup 4): USART3_IRQn = 0 and DMA1_Stream0_IRQn = 0 (highest, PIL transport, never preempted); TIM7_IRQn = 15 (lowest, HAL tick can be deferred); TIM5 has no IRQ enabled (free-running, read directly via TIM5->CNT) so it cannot preempt the PIL serial. The PIL ELF is built with -O3 (BuildConfiguration = 'Faster Runs').

The bms_master PIL ELF static RAM footprint (initialised .data + zero-initialised .bss) SHALL stay below req.RT_RAM_max_kb on the STM32H7A3ZI-Q (1.4 MB on-chip SRAM available), measured by arm-none-eabi-size on the linked ELF after a Faster-Runs build. This bounds the runtime memory needed for model state, LSTM weights and code-execution profiling buffers, leaving headroom for HAL, FreeRTOS-style tasks and stack growth.

The embedded LSTM fault predictor, executing inside bms_master on the STM32H7A3 (ARM Cortex-M7 @ 280 MHz) in PIL mode, SHALL produce prob_3 outputs with a maximum absolute error <= 1e-3 per class compared to MIL reference values, across the OT, OV and UV fault scenarios. This confirms correct floating-point operation, memory layout and LSTM inference pipeline on the target processor.

Cumulative Simulink Coverage of bms_master, bms_slave and fault_predictor under the BMS MIL stimulus set SHALL leave no more than req.COV_dead_pct_max (default 0 %) of design blocks unexecuted. Execution coverage is the canonical model-level dead-code proxy: an unexecuted block is unreachable design. Decision, Condition and MCDC results are recorded in the report as informational stimulus-coverage metrics only and do not gate the verdict.
